unsupported: TUCS Equipment Inc. operates from Princeton, Minnesota, where founder Marty Tucs and his Food Process Equipment Team established the company to address food processing challenges.
The company manufactures a range of food processing equipment, including systems for cooking, chilling, packaging, and product handling, serving both foodservice operators and large-scale processors.
Its equipment is designed for commercial kitchens, industrial food production lines, and related foodservice environments, addressing cooking, chilling, packaging, and handling needs.
